description: Create a new campaign reward (reward config) on your GrowSurf program. `type` must be compatible with the program type (affiliate programs support only AFFILIATE rewards; referral programs support the other types). Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

commissionStructure.description: Affiliate commission structure (AFFILIATE rewards only). Provide a positive `amount` (+ optional `amountISO`) for a FIXED commission, or `percent` for a PERCENT commission. CLICK and LEAD commissions must use FIXED.

amount.description: Amount in minor currency units (the currency's smallest denomination). For USD, $100.00 is `10000`. The maximum is `100000000` (1,000,000.00) for USD, EUR, and GBP.

event.description: The affiliate event that earns the commission. `CLICK` and `LEAD` must use `FIXED`.

introAmount.description: Amount in minor currency units (the currency's smallest denomination). For USD, $100.00 is `10000`.

maxAmount.description: Amount in minor currency units (the currency's smallest denomination). For USD, $100.00 is `10000`.

event.description: The referral event that earns this Campaign Reward. Use `LEAD` for a referred signup or `CONVERSION` for a qualifying action. A `LEAD` reward requires a later custom conversion trigger. Referral reward types only.

imageIconKey.description: The starter icon shown for the reward, or `null` when `imageUrl` is your own image. Participant pages draw this icon in your program's accent color. Also set `imageUrl` to the icon's image so the iOS and Android SDKs can show it. Sending `imageUrl` without `imageIconKey` clears it.

metadata.description: Custom key/value metadata. Sending it replaces the stored object. Each value must be a string, number, or boolean of up to 500 characters. Each key must have 1 to 40 characters once camelCased, and two keys that camelCase to the same key are rejected. Up to 50 keys. An entry that breaks these rules returns `400`. For DOUBLE_SIDED referral rewards, `rewardAmount` is the referrer's amount and `referredRewardAmount` the friend's; without `referredRewardAmount` the friend uses `rewardAmount` unless `referralDescription` is a percent or free offer. Positive amounts use whole units for zero-decimal currencies and at most two decimals otherwise.

referredValue.description: Tax valuation for the referred friend's side of a double-sided reward. `taxCharacter` is the reason the recipient earns the reward. For configurable non-commission rewards, `null` inherits the program's confirmed treatment. Commission rewards have no referred-friend side, so GrowSurf clears these settings. Use `PURCHASE_REBATE` only when that is the correct tax character.

value.description: Tax valuation for the reward (the referrer's side of a double-sided reward). `fairMarketValueUSD` is the manual fair-market value in USD (major units). `taxCharacter` is the reason the recipient earns the reward. For configurable non-commission rewards, `null` inherits the program's confirmed treatment. Commission rewards always use `NONEMPLOYEE_SERVICES`.

name: growsurf_create_campaign_reward

outputSchema.description: The created campaign reward. Same shape as the items in the `growsurf_list_campaign_rewards` result.

title: Create Campaign Reward
